name: Magento Self-Hosted
description: Magento Open Source and on-premises Adobe Commerce provide customer-operated digital storefronts with catalogs, inventory, pricing, carts, checkout, orders, customers, content, extensions, and administration.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact public HTTPS URL for a customer-owned Magento Open Source or on-premises Adobe Commerce installation and one selected storefront-visible product SKU. Relay sends one fixed unauthenticated core Commerce GraphQL product query and exposes only that SKU plus in-stock or out-of-stock status while excluding product content, pricing, inventory quantities, customers, carts, orders, configuration, administration, authenticated APIs, broader queries, introspection, and all mutations.

credentialRequirements.name: MAGENTO_SELF_HOSTED_BASE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Magento HTTPS commerce base URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact public HTTPS URL for one customer-owned Magento Open Source or on-premises Adobe Commerce installation, including its install path if present; Relay rejects embedded credentials, unsafe paths, private DNS, queries, and fragments.

credentialRequirements.name: MAGENTO_SELF_HOSTED_PRODUCT_SKU
credentialRequirements.label: Selected public product SKU
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact SKU of the single storefront-visible product Relay may inspect through the public core Commerce GraphQL API; V1 accepts only letters, numbers, dot, underscore, and hyphen.

capabilities.label: Read selected product stock status
capabilities.description: Read only one selected public product SKU and its in-stock or out-of-stock status without product content, pricing, inventory quantities, customer, cart, order, or private commerce data.

allowed.label: Read selected product stock status
allowed.description: Read only one selected public product SKU and its in-stock or out-of-stock status.

blocked.label: Expose private commerce or product data
blocked.description: Names, descriptions, prices, images, URLs, attributes, categories, reviews, inventory quantities, customer data, carts, orders, and private commerce data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Magento or Adobe Commerce
blocked.description: Products, inventory, carts, checkout, orders, customers, configuration, extensions, content, users, files, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad commerce access
blocked.description: Other products, search, lists, categories, arbitrary GraphQL, introspection, REST, SOAP, administration, authenticated access, redirects, and bulk access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Public Product Stock Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected public product's stock status; product content, pricing, customers, carts, orders, administration, authenticated access, broader queries, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores two nonsecret selected boundaries and mounts exactly one unauthenticated fixed public GraphQL product-stock query.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer-owned Magento Open Source or on-premises Adobe Commerce staging installation reachable at an exact public HTTPS URL and one storefront-visible product SKU are required. No authorized staging installation is available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The external setup lane must nominate a staging installation and exact storefront-visible SKU, record only those nonsecret boundaries in Railway, then validate the projected core GraphQL read, public-DNS/base-path/fixed-SKU enforcement, content and pricing redaction, missing-product behavior, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax. No Magento token, Admin account, integration, provider console, or consent is required.

evidence.supports: Adobe documents the PaaS and Magento Open Source core Commerce GraphQL endpoint at the customer-operated commerce URL plus /graphql.
Adobe documents GraphQL queries over HTTP POST with application/json and shows a product-by-SKU query; authorization is an optional header for queries that require customer or admin identity.

Adobe documents the core products query for Adobe Commerce PaaS and Magento Open Source, including an exact SKU filter and stock_status in the response; Relay requests and retains only SKU and stock status.
